text: こんどは　すごく　かてるきが　するぞ！

structure.jp: すごく　かてるきが　するぞ！
structure.en: I really feel I can win!

patterns.name: 〜気がする
patterns.explanation: A statement plus きがする means 'I have a feeling that'. かてるきが　する = 'I feel like I can win'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to the え-row plus る means 'can do'. かつ 'win' becomes かてる = 'can win'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. きが　するぞ = 'I've got a feeling, I tell you!'
